BOX step 6 — production: actual vs Novi 2025Q3 vs BOX

Delaware WCA hindcast · Novi 2025Q3 · BOX rebuilt from wells first-producing before 2024-12-01, production through 2025-06-01 · actuals curated.production through 2026-07-01 (each well's newest month dropped) · blueox-boxfit @ 3380317
Novi line = the matched stick's 2025Q3 forecast scaled to the drilled lateral (the per-ft basis sql/43 scores). BOX = area cohort-MEAN curve (D32) × lateral × ref_mult × scenario factor (gas at the local GOR level, D30/D46); solid = BOX of record (calendar factor F(k) applied, D36 — what was scored at months 6 and 12), dashed = uptime-free curve. Averages: month k is the mean over the wells that have month k reported (n on hover; later months rest on fewer wells); the cumulative view cumulates those monthly means.
